subject: planner: use code-gen to generate CloneForPlanCache method for some operators (#54601)
summary: Adds code-generated `CloneForPlanCache` for several physical operators (TableScan/IndexScan/Selection/Projection) plus supporting plan-cache clone tags/helpers; also makes `(*expression.Schema).Clone()` nil-safe and adds `util.CloneByItems`. No remaining Blocker/High issues in-scope after checking later upstream/master history.
